notes: NEVER use the-saleroom.com (or collect any house through it): its terms (cl. 3.2, 6.1) forbid systematic downloading and spidering.

Rules per house are in docs/RULES.md. A house whose terms forbid copying or using catalogue text (or whose terms cannot be read) stays enabled:false with the verdict quoted in disabled_reason: it is not collected at all.
content_policy (every house): "full" = description + image link; "text_only" = description only, image_url is always null. See SPEC.md.
crawl_delay is in seconds (never below 3; 10 where robots.txt says so).
adapter must be a name from collector/sources/__init__.py (null = no adapter planned). An enabled house whose adapter is not written yet is simply skipped.

goauction houses also need calendar_urls (pages listing the sales; {month} is replaced by YYYY-MM). Optional: sale_include, sale_exclude, max_pages, max_lots_per_sale, max_new_lot_pages (default 150 new lot pages per run), calendar_months. See collector/sources/goauction.py.

whitelabel houses need calendar_urls (pages listing the sales). Optional: sale_include, sale_exclude (regexes on the sale title and its summary line), max_pages, max_new_lot_pages. See collector/sources/whitelabel.py.
api_allowed: true (default false) lets a house use an /api or search JSON endpoint through Fetcher.post_json; none has it (docs/RULES.md, v0.4 Decision).

sale_include_extra adds words to the shared art-sale words. gorringes: calendar_urls, max_calendar_pages, lots_url. lawrences: calendar_urls, catalogue_base, catalogue_section, lookahead_days. rogersjones: calendar_urls. duggleby: auctions_api, lots_api (off, see RULES.md).

keep_existing_lots: true keeps a house's stored lots (until their sales end) while it is switched off only because we cannot collect it right now. Without it, switching a house off removes its lots at the next run.
